note: Files outside libs/plugins/ai/src/lib/providers that still carry a vendor AI literal while the last of the AI code moves into the plugin (AGL-2939). Read by check-ai-in-core.mjs, which is red for a literal in a file missing here AND for a row whose file no longer carries one. This list may shrink and must never grow: a new vendor literal is refused, not recorded.

files.why: The usage meter's rate table keys the per-model list rates by model id. It moves into the plugin with the meter in the phase that follows AGL-2928's per-user rollups; the plugin's catalog already carries the same table.
The subprocessor registry names the vendor's host because DISCLOSING the relationship is its purpose. It derives from the active provider once a plugin-declared subprocessor seam exists.
